meta.title: Dreaming memory
meta.description: Review completed work, correct project memories against recorded evidence, and recall useful lessons in future sessions.

ui.subtitle: What your agent has learned — with the evidence behind every memory.
ui.configureProjects: Add the absolute project directories to the Dreaming plugin’s projectRoots setting, then reload this page.
ui.adjustFilters: Try another search term or filter.
ui.firstDream: Complete a conversation in this project, then run Dreaming to extract useful memories.
ui.selectMemoryBody: Choose a note to read its contents and source evidence.
ui.evidenceHint: These excerpts support the memory. Session ID and event number identify the original record.
ui.confirmForgetBody: It will be removed from current memory. Previous revisions and original conversations remain available.
ui.confirmRollbackBody: This creates a new revision using the selected version’s memories and processing cursors. Existing history is preserved.
ui.historyHint: Each saved revision records a point in time. Restore an earlier version to undo a memory change.
